landing_subtitle: Upload or capture a leaf photo. A YOLOv8 model trained on the PlantDoc dataset finds the disease, estimates severity and suggests a treatment.
step1_text: Upload a leaf image or use the camera.
step2_text: YOLOv8 locates the leaf and classifies its condition (28 PlantDoc classes).
step3_text: See confidence, severity, plant health and a treatment suggestion.
scan_hint: Tip: one leaf, filling most of the frame, in good light.
results_empty: No scan available. Please go to the Scan page.
disclaimer: Decision support only. Confirm with a local agronomist before spraying.
